create_SceneTypeSpec: create a SceneTypeSpec dataclass to define a scene type with name, game master, and default premise
create_SceneSpec: create a SceneSpec dataclass to define a specific scene with participants, rounds, and start time
build_SceneTypeSpec_with_premise: build a SceneTypeSpec with a default premise mapping player names to pre-scene messages
build_SceneSpec_with_action_spec: build a SceneSpec with a custom action spec for agents to produce during scene steps
review_SceneTypeSpec_possible_participan: review the SceneTypeSpec possible_participants field to filter scene participants by intersection
